name: bielu-persistentqueues-workspace
description: Root workspace for changeset-driven versioning of this repository. Not published. build/changeset/nuget-suite is the private placeholder package standing in for the shared NuGet version of the four Bielu.PersistentQueues packages.

scripts.version: changeset version && node scripts/apply-nuget-version.mjs && npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund
